title: Perform Daily Preventive Maintenance Inspection on OptiSweep Hospital Station(s)
summary: Perform a daily inspection of each OptiSweep hospital station to verify the barcode scanner is operational, the stacklight is operational, and the tabletop is free of debris.
when_to_use: Use this daily checklist to verify each hospital station is safe to operate by confirming (1) barcode scanner operational status, (2) stacklight operational status, and (3) tabletop is free of debris.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical/visual inspection at each hospital station and escalate to maintenance support if any required item fails.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to each OptiSweep hospital station

visual_references.description: Diagram of the Hospital Station layout showing induct and extract sides and the location of the green barcode scanner (used to orient the inspection).
Photo/figure of the hospital station stacklight with labeled light states (used to judge whether the stacklight is operational).
Photo of a hospital station showing the stacklight and station physical layout (used to locate the stacklight and station components).

steps.title: Inspect the barcode scanner at each hospital station
steps.purpose: Confirm the hospital station barcode scanner is operational as required for safe operation.
steps.instruction: For each OptiSweep hospital station, visually inspect the hospital station barcode scanner and confirm it is operational.
steps.expected_result: For the station being inspected, the barcode scanner is operational.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode scanner is operational (pass condition per daily PM checklist).

actions.label: Visual check barcode scanner operational
actions.exact_action: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The barcode scanner is operational.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The barcode scanner is operational.

steps.title: Inspect the hospital station stacklight
steps.purpose: Confirm the hospital station stacklight is operational as required for safe operation.
steps.instruction: For each OptiSweep hospital station, inspect the stacklight and confirm it is operational.
steps.expected_result: For the station being inspected, the stacklight is operational.
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklight is operational (pass condition per daily PM checklist).

actions.label: Visual check stacklight operational
actions.exact_action: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The stacklight is operational.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The stacklight is operational.

Figure 3-6: Solid Red (Default/Indeterminate), Solid Green (No AGV present at the station), Red/Yellow/Green (RMS error), Flashing Red (Fault), Flashing Yellow for 15 seconds (AGV is present at either position of the station).

steps.title: Inspect the hospital station tabletop for debris
steps.purpose: Confirm the tabletop is free of debris to support safe operation.
steps.instruction: For each OptiSweep hospital station, inspect the tabletop and remove/confirm absence of debris.
steps.expected_result: For the station being inspected, the tabletop is free of debris.
steps.healthy_condition: No debris present on the tabletop.
steps.failure_condition: Debris is present on the tabletop.

actions.label: Visual check tabletop debris
actions.exact_action: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The tabletop is free of debris.

stop_or_escalate_if: Debris is present on the tabletop

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect each hospital station for the following: The tabletop is free of debris.

steps.title: Stop inspection and escalate if any required item fails
steps.purpose: Prevent unsafe operation by escalating when any daily PM checklist item fails.
steps.instruction: If any barcode scanner issue is observed, if the stacklight is not operational, or if debris is present on the tabletop, stop the inspection and escalate to maintenance support.
steps.expected_result: Inspection is stopped for the failing condition and maintenance support is engaged.
steps.healthy_condition: No failures observed; inspection can continue to the next station.
steps.failure_condition: At least one of: barcode scanner not operational, stacklight not operational, debris present on tabletop.

actions.label: Escalate to maintenance support
actions.exact_action: If any barcode scanner issue is observed, if the stacklight is not operational, or if debris is present on the tabletop, stop the inspection and escalate to maintenance support.

stop_or_escalate_if: Debris is present on the tabletop

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Daily preventive maintenance checklist items for hospital station include barcode scanner operational, stacklight operational, and tabletop free of debris.

success_criteria: For every hospital station inspected: barcode scanner is operational, stacklight is operational, and tabletop is free of debris.
healthy_conditions: Barcode scanner is operational at each inspected hospital station.
Stacklight is operational at each inspected hospital station.
Tabletop is free of debris at each inspected hospital station.
failure_conditions: Barcode scanner is not operational at any inspected hospital station.
Stacklight is not operational at any inspected hospital station.
Debris is present on the tabletop at any inspected hospital station.
escalation_guidance: Stop the inspection and escalate to maintenance support if any barcode scanner issue is observed, if the stacklight is not operational, or if debris is present on the tabletop.
